summary: Parent-reported: Lakshmi describes Ravi, age 40 months, who used a few words at age 2 and then stopped talking; he has no words now. She reports little eye contact, no turning to his name, solitary play with lining up of cars, repeated cartoon lines, hand flapping when excited, covering his ears at kitchen sounds, big tantrums when the school route changes and hitting his own head when upset. Sleep is late and he eats only rice and curd. A younger uncle also started talking late. Everything here is parent-reported and needs to be checked in the session.

red_flags.quote: at age 2 he said a few words like amma and ball, then he stopped talking
he hits his own head with his hand when he is upset

questions_to_verify: Which words did Ravi use before he stopped talking, and how did the loss happen?
Does Ravi respond to his name in the session when called from behind?
How often does the head hitting happen, and has he ever been injured?
Does Ravi use any gestures, such as pulling a hand, to ask for things?
How does Ravi react to sudden sounds in the clinic?
